description: Night light sources for the probe bake. Coordinates are source/scene.blend metres (X = -world_z/100, Y = -world_x/100, Z = world_y/100). Colours are linear RGB. Emission strength is Blender emission strength; area/spot power is Blender watts. Absolute levels do not matter much: each group is baked separately and scaled per group when the result is imported into the game.
